claims.statement: Leonardo recorded an observation in Rimini dated 8 August 1502.
claims.confidence_basis: Urbino University Press binds the dated observation to Manuscript L folio 78r; independent evidence review is still pending.

claims.statement: Leonardo was present in Cesena by 10 August 1502 in the selected survey context.
claims.confidence_basis: Urbino University Press binds the 10 August Cesena entry to Manuscript L folio 46v; independent evidence review is still pending.

claims.statement: The selected Cesena survey context is associated with Manuscript L folios 9r through 10r.
claims.confidence_basis: The folio range is named by the institutional itinerary but is distinct from the dated 10 August entry at folio 46v; direct facsimile or critical-edition verification remains pending.

claims.statement: Cesare Borgia's letter patent for Leonardo is dated 18 August 1502.
claims.confidence_basis: The university chronology reproduces the full patent text and dating formula at printed p. 16 n. 26; independent evidence review is still pending.

claims.statement: Leonardo recorded the Cesenatico port context on 6 September 1502.
claims.confidence_basis: Urbino University Press binds the dated Cesenatico entry to Manuscript L folio 66v; independent evidence review is still pending.

claims.statement: The selected dated Cesenatico port entry is associated with Manuscript L folio 66v.
claims.confidence_basis: The university chronology transcribes the dated entry and identifies folio 66v; folio 68r is not used as evidence for the exact date.

claims.statement: Royal Collection item 912284 associates Leonardo's Imola map with his autumn 1502 work context.
claims.confidence_basis: Specific collection item candidate; the exact supporting catalogue passage still requires review.

claims.statement: Royal Collection item 912686 catalogues Leonardo's sketches of the street plan of Imola.
claims.confidence_basis: The collection identity is stable, but the source object has not been reviewed for historical geometry use.

claims.statement: The selected sources describe Leonardo as serving Cesare Borgia in an engineering capacity during 1502.
claims.confidence_basis: The published patent transcription supports the commissioned title; the exact end of the State and original-document custody locator remain unresolved.

claims.statement: The Metropolitan Museum of Art chronology dates the rule of Isma'il I to 1501 through 1524.
claims.confidence_basis: Specific institutional chronology entry; content review has not yet occurred.

uncertainties.description: Stable university-press locators now bind the dated Rimini, Cesena and Cesenatico entries to folios 78r, 46v and 66v, but no rights-cleared facsimile is frozen and the Cesena wall-survey folios 9r–10r still rely on the institutional itinerary.
uncertainties.effect: The bibliographic locators are reviewable, but manuscript-based Claims remain draft until independent content review; the Cesena wall-survey folio association remains especially unresolved.

uncertainties.description: A university-press critical transcription is pinned, and Treccani identifies Archivio Melzi d'Eril in Vaprio d'Adda as the original-document custody location, but no archival call number or rights-cleared surrogate is available in the package.
uncertainties.effect: The date and commissioned title can undergo textual review, while original-object provenance, physical inspection and media reuse remain unresolved.
